name: MMArt-Bench
description:
JarvisArt: Liberating Human Artistic Creativity via an Intelligent Photo Retouching Agent.

	
		
		🌍 Introduction
	

MMArt-Bench. To provide a comprehensive evaluation of JarvisArt’s performance, we introduce the MMArt-Bench, which is sampled from the MMArt dataset. It includes four main scenarios: portrait, landscape, street scenes, and still life, with 50 instances per category, totaling 200 instances. Each primary category contains multiple subcategories. evaluation_method: human_eval (subjective quality/preference) with possible region-level objective metrics (e.g., PSNR/SSIM)
reputation: A specialized dataset for photo retouching and artistic quality assessment with limited adoption outside the originating project.
